answer.new_information: Per The Diplomat, citing SPF, Singapore seized a property valued at about S$55 million and charged four people with money laundering in a case involving servers that may have contained Nvidia AI chips. The statement dated to the article day (2026-07-02, publication day, not confirmed as the statement day). The servers were reportedly shipped from Singapore to Malaysia; the ultimate destination is unclear and some media suggested China. No Nvidia statement, sales, or company role is reported. The case concerns Aperia Group and other entities, not Nvidia.
